title: urn:qauth:ia:logout_confirm:v1-rc.0
description: The confirmation of an RP-initiated logout (ADR-019 Decision 4). The interaction’s `client` names the app that asked, when the request identified one. A browser may hold several accounts’ sessions, so the person signs out of this account or of every account on the browser (ADR-019 Decision 3). Works without JavaScript, without the account list.

decision.description: Sign out of this account, of every account on the browser, or stay signed in.

accounts.description: The accounts signed in on this browser, the one being signed out first.

identifier.description: The identifier of the account this transaction is for, as the person gave it or as the account holds it. Personal data: only the personal-data read returns it.

current.description: Whether this is the account the logout request is for.

amr.description: The RFC 8176 `amr` values a successful answer adds to the transaction: none, because the step proves no authenticator.
